## Signed in (account created the same evening)
- the shop is be.eurocircuits.com; signing in at www.eurocircuits.com does not carry over – sign in on the shop's page
  (eclogin.aspx); registration: an account opens after its details are completed (business accounts checked first)
- signed in, the left menu: Customer Report, Calculate and order, Analyze My Data, Order Stencils, Shopping basket,
  View running orders, Order repeats / view history, Projects, Data feedback, Aftersales support, …
- Gerber upload as before (hidden dropzone inputs: the tool reaches one after an aria-label set by JS on
  element.dropzone.hiddenFileInput)
- ticking "Check to Include Assembly Service" opens the dialog "Import your BoM – Drop your BOM here – BROWSE" at once
- BOM: bom_step0_mpn.csv (Designator, Quantity, Value, Package, Manufacturer, Manufacturer Part Number) taken without a column
  dialog; R1 identified by MPN: "0805W8F1002T5E – Chip Resistor - Surface Mount 10KOhms ±1% 1/8W 0805 RoHS", Uniroyal Elec,
  Availability "On Demand", Supplied by Assembler, Price "No info" -> "Incomplete component price because 1 Part(s) with no
  price info"; counters Identified parts, eC-stock parts, On Demand, Generic parts, Reserved Stock, Parts Pre-Order,
  Unidentified, Suggested, Obsolete, NRND; Supplied by Assembler | Customer | Not placed | Mixed supply
  -> one bom_<b>_mpn.csv serves PCBWay and Eurocircuits (answers the TODO item's question for these two)
- CPL: cpl_step0.csv in JLCPCB's columns (Designator, Mid X, Mid Y "10mm", Layer "Top", Rotation) taken; "Assembly Editor":
  Component placements – Source: cpl_step0.csv; Bird's Eye View Top/Bottom, Detailed View, Component thumbnails, Tools (Switch
  view, Show component rotation, Rotate left/right, Set centroid, Offset, Invert rotation, Swap sides, Delete); Component list
  R1 10.000 10.000 0 Top "0805W8F1002T5E – Uniroyal Elec", SMD; "Ignore not placed", "Import CPL"; Cancel | Apply
- PCBA panel: "Special assembly requirements" No|Yes, "Automotive required" No|Yes, "Do not assemble all PCBs"; Total lead
  time "Proposed (12 working days)" with assembly
- Summary tab: Item | Quantity | Total lead time | Unit price | VAT | Gross | Add to cart (a checkbox per line: PCB ticked,
  Assembly and Components not); PCB € 72.08, Assembly € 271.20 gross, Components (Incomplete) € 0.00; "The gross prices
  include 20 % VAT" (Austria); fields PCB Name * (the file name), Purchase reference, Project reference, Article reference,
  SMS notification; "Check this box to Accept the Eurocircuits Terms of Sales *" (required, NOT pre-checked – a consent in
  the owner's name: the skill stops and asks; the owner agreed for the test board); "Check this box if you Require
  Pre-Production Approval" (pre-checked); buttons "Add to basket" | "Launch inquiry"
  -> profile cart = "Add to basket" (not "Save to Basket" – that is the configurator's hint text)
- "Add to basket" with assembly data but the Assembly line unticked opens "Include PCBA service – You have uploaded Assembly
  Data but PCBA service is not included in your cart along with PCB": "Yes, Include PCBA & Continue" | "No, Continue
  Without PCBA" – the skill ticks the lines it wants before
- basket (/shop/orders/basketitems.aspx): "Shopping basket – To start the manufacturing process, select an item(s) and
  "Proceed to checkout" !"; buttons Proceed to checkout (never), Calculate SmartPool, Modify, Modify Copy, View details,
  Downloads, Delete, History, Edit administrative details; columns PCB Visualizer® | Assembly Visualizer | Remarks | Offer |
  Basket number | Project | Type | Status | PCB Name | Service | Quantity | Assembly qty | Delivery days | prices
- M-2: YES – "Assembly Visualizer" in the basket row opens "Modify: <basket number>" with the PCBA visualizer, and its
  "CPL Editor" shows the placement again
- Terms of Sales (custom PCB, PCBA and stencil, "Revision Date: 10-April-2025", a PDF behind "Read More") and Terms of Use
